description_en: Restores databases or tables to a PolarDB cluster
name: RestoreTable

parameters.description_en:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters in your account.
parameters.description_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查询账号下所有集群的信息详情。
parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters in your account
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查询账号下所有集群的信息详情
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.description_en:
A JSON string that specifies the destination databases and tables to restore. All values in the JSON string must be strings.
For example: `[ { "tables":[ { "name":"testtb", "type":"table", "newname":"testtb_restore" } ], "name":"testdb", "type":"db", "newname":"testdb_restore" } ]`.

> Call the [DescribeMetaList](~~194770~~) operation to query the names of the databases and tables that can be restored. Then, enter the information into the example format.

parameters.name: table_meta

parameters.description_en:
The backup set ID.

> This parameter is required if you want to restore databases and tables from a backup set. Call the [DescribeBackups](~~98102~~) operation to query backup set IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
备份集ID。
> 若需要按备份集还原目标库表，该参数必传。您可以通过[DescribeBackups](~~98102~~)接口查看备份集ID。

parameters.description_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

> - This parameter is required if you want to restore data to a specific point in time.
>
> - Data can be restored to any point in time within the last seven days.
parameters.description_zh:
还原时间点，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ（UTC时间）。
>* 若需要按时间点还原，该参数必填。
>* 仅支持恢复到7天内的任意时间点。
